title: JSXGraph board in a tab: reproduction
text:
This page is built on its own, with old commits: the JSXGraph Quarto extension as ctm-demo used it on 22 September 2026 (math-exercise dad1ddd; its filter is the same as jsxgraph-quarto main 59d549c) and the original code of the solenoid figure (ctm-demo 60b1cb0). The JSXGraph library itself is loaded from the CDN, as then.
To see the problem:

Open the tab 2025, then Prøve 4. The board shows correctly.
Make the window narrow, or turn a phone to portrait. The board keeps its wide size and is cut off on the right; it does not follow the page.
